dialogues.text: "As the black day draws near, Aurelius fell; Aurelius fell, and the whole world trembled."

dialogues.speaker: Performance Bulletin
dialogues.text: Intro: The third and final part of the Aurelius trilogy of plays, based upon the epic legend "The Saga of Aurelius."

dialogues.speaker: Performance Bulletin
dialogues.text: Go back to the final moments of a hero's life, and witness the dying light of an ancient empire.
